overrides.reason: OpenNGC follows NED and lists M102 as a duplicate of M101 (type Dup). This catalogue follows the common observing identification instead.
NGC 5866 is listed as M102, matching Stellarium and most observing guides.

normalisations: RA HH:MM:SS.ss -> decimal hours (6 dp); Dec ±DD:MM:SS.s -> decimal degrees (6 dp), sign taken from the string

commonName: first entry of the Common names column, or null

Galaxy V-Mag: where B-V would be below 0.2, or OpenNGC has no V-Mag, V is B-Mag minus the median B-V of the catalogue's own credible galaxies of the same Hubble group (per object: overrides, action vMagColour)
